set -e; ip addr flush dev sp1-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.11.2/30 dev sp1-eth0; ip link set sp1-eth0 up; ip addr flush dev sp1-eth1; ip addr add 10.0.21.2/30 dev sp1-eth1; ip link set sp1-eth1 up; ip addr add 10.255.0.1/32 dev lo; ip link set lo up; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; d=/var/run/frr/mnr-clos-sp1; mkdir -p $d /etc/frr/mnr-clos-sp1; : > /etc/frr/mnr-clos-sp1/vtysh.conf; chown frr:frr $d; chmod 775 $d; printf 'hostname %s\nlog file %s/zebra-runtime.log\n' sp1 "$d" > $d/zebra.conf; printf 'hostname sp1
log file %s/bgpd-runtime.log
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.255.0.1
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 10.0.11.1 remote-as 65001
 neighbor 10.0.21.1 remote-as 65002
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.255.0.1/32
  maximum-paths 2
 exit-address-family
' "$d" > $d/bgpd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-clos-sp1 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/bgpd -d -N mnr-clos-sp1 -f $d/bgpd.conf -i $d/bgpd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/bgpd.log 2>&1

ip addr flush dev h1-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.1.2/24 dev h1-eth0; ip link set h1-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.10.1.1
ip addr flush dev h2-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.2.2/24 dev h2-eth0; ip link set h2-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.10.2.1
for n in 10.0.11.2 10.0.12.2; do vtysh -N mnr-clos-lf1 -c "show bgp neighbors $n" | grep -q 'BGP state = Established' || exit 1; done
n=$(ip route show 10.10.2.0/24 | grep -c nexthop); test "$n" -ge 2 && ip route show 10.10.2.0/24
ip link set dev lf1-eth0 down
ip link set dev lf1-eth0 up
